reviewed_clauses.verbatim_extracted_text:
6.1    Only medicines registered in Samoa, or internationally recognized   by authorities 
such as TGA and FDA shall be distributed in the country. Any outstanding or new 
medicines to be brought into the country must be in accordance with the Food and 
Drugs Act 1967.
